about: Tables of yours whose rows an ID change may drop: rows that only mark progress against game data, or a choice of it (a game in your library, a rule in a set), and mean nothing once it is gone or when the row already on the new ID says the same. Any other row needs the ID to become another (or a link that can be cleared). Read by src/platform/local-db/id-changes.ts and the release checks.
